title: Companies Are Realizing They're Spending a Fortune on AI Just So Their Employees Can Generate Error-Riddled Slop, and Suddenly Cutting Back Budgets
hook_text: Companies are slashing their AI budgets.
script:
Companies are suddenly cutting back their AI budgets because employees keep generating error-ridden work.
Futurism reported that firms spent a fortune on generative tools only to get slop.
Workers relied on the software to write text and code that turned out flawed.
Bosses noticed the steep subscription costs did not match the poor output quality.
Firms are now pulling back funds from these expensive deployments.
Will your office keep its subscription next month?

editor.one_line: Too generic and lacks concrete company names or hard financial figures.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Name specific firms instead of saying 'companies' to immediately grab attention.
LINE 2: Include the estimated total dollar amount spent on these failed tools.
LINE 3: Name the specific software or model types employees used.

line 3: Pure white background flash lacks context and visual variety.
line 5: Text on screen ('Pulling back funds') repeats concepts without adding visual data or proof
